description: In front of you is an open brown shelf unit beside a toy dishwasher, with several clear plastic food containers stacked inside. The right hand reaches into the shelf, grips a clear container and pulls it forward and down to the tabletop, then reaches in again to remove another container; the right hand also lifts a small square container and finally takes out a green-lidded container, setting each one down so the stack inside becomes unstacked and the containers end up grouped on the table, while the left hand stays low and mostly idle.
